title: Worker sample review
finding: Operator review of the PaddleOCR-VL worker (protocol 1.1, CPU) against `pdf_inspector`, `liteparse` and a dots.mocr probe on `bd03` p1–p2 (control) and `io06` p28, p53 (old book), plus `eq01` p11 (equations). Control guard passes: no damage on clean pages. `io06/28`: text readers `empty`, worker readable with one invented-text defect. Text readers not LLM-ready on equations; both OCR engines give correct LaTeX. dots.mocr named best on 5/5 pages. `io04`/`tl03` not reviewed. Task 2.3 proceeds for `io06`-class pages
